## 一個簡單的數據包，為 [Man of Many Planes](https://modrinth.com/mod/man-of-many-planes) 添加了 2 個 Create 配方 

需要 [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)、[Man of Many Planes](https://modrinth.com/mod/man-of-many-planes) 和 [Immersive Aircraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-aircraft)

建議搭配 [Create Immersive Aircrafts - Recipes](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/create-immersive-aircrafts-data-pack) 和 [Create Immersive Aircrafts](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/create-immersive-aircrafts-resource-pack) 使用

### 配方：
- **經濟型飛機**
![經濟型飛機及其在機械製造機中的配方截圖，背景為山脈與樹木](https://github.com/Fugimii/Create-Man-of-Many-Planes/blob/main/images/2024-05-30_18.12.17.jpg?raw=true)

- **猩紅雙翼機**
![猩紅雙翼機及其在機械製造機中的配方截圖，背景為山脈與樹木](https://github.com/Fugimii/Create-Man-of-Many-Planes/blob/main/images/2024-05-30_18.10.07.jpg?raw=true)

## 歡迎將其加入整合包 :)
